chunks: And from him, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Al-Mi'za, from Dharih Al-Muharibi, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'What I endure from my people and my children when I inform them of the good in visiting the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is that they call me a liar and say,

He (peace be upon him) said: 'O Dharih! Leave the people; let them go wherever they wish. By Allah, Allah boasts about the visitor of Al-Husayn, and the one who arrives is welcomed by the near angels and the bearers of His Throne.
Indeed, He says to them: 'Do you not see the visitors of the grave of Al-Husayn? They have come to him yearning for him and for Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah.
By My honor, My majesty, and My greatness, I will surely ordain for them My honor, and I will surely bring them into My Paradise, which I have prepared for My friends, My prophets, and My messengers.
O My angels! These are the visitors of Al-Husayn, the beloved of Muhammad, My Messenger, and Muhammad is My beloved.
And whoever loves Me, loves My beloved; and whoever loves My beloved, loves the one whom he loves; and whoever hates My beloved, hates Me.

And whoever hates Me, it is incumbent upon Me to torment him with My severest torment, to burn him with the heat of My fire, and to make Hell his dwelling and his abode, and I will torment him with a torment that I do not torment anyone else with among the worlds.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Sadiq’s reassurance to Dharih that divine validation outweighs human skepticism, highlighting the concept of *al-Mubahah* (Allah boasting to angels) regarding visitors of Imam al-Husayn. This narration underscores the Shia theological principle of *Hubb al-Ahl al-Bayt* as a prerequisite for salvation, linking the love of the Prophet’s family directly to the love of Allah and the intercession of the angels.
